messages:
sam: From the postmortem (#498) we need concrete test artifacts we can run in CI. Goal: prevent regression and capture the incident signals. Quick plan below, please volunteer.

sam: Items: 1) regression suite for the failing customer flows, 2) two prompt sets (billing + safety), 3) short burst load test (90-120s), 4) mini chaos drill on staging. Link everything back to #498.

lee: I'll pick up the regression suite. plan: smoke tests for critical prompts + token-diff detector + latency assertions. I'll add a GH action matrix to run on variants v1.4 and v1.4-quant. Draft PR by Mon.

nina: I'll assemble prompt sets from the incident logs (billing/account prompts) and a safety-edge set. Will strip PII with a small anonymizer script and add metadata (source, repro steps). Target: Tue.

alex: I'll build the load burst harness: ramp to 180 qps over 30s, hold 90s, collect p50/p95/p99 + cost metrics. Add as nightly optional job until thumbs-up. Opening draft today.

pat: ops: can we run a focused chaos drill in staging next Wed 14:00 UTC? scope: evict one GPU pod then kill a control-plane replica. ops-bot: please create invite and post runbook.

ops-bot: Chaos drill scheduled: Wed 14:00 UTC (30m window) on staging. Invite sent to eng-ml, eng-sre, oncall. Runbook: https://go/drills/498. Reminder 24h prior. :robot_face:

sam: File locations: put promptsets under infra/evals/promptsets/incident-498.yaml and tests under tests/regression/incident_498_test.py. Also add a changelog entry infra/evals/changes/498.md referencing PRs.

lee: will include matrix: variants: ["v1.4","v1.4-quant"], and a simple run command: `pytest tests/regression/incident_498_test.py::test_critical_flow`.

nina: anonymizer note: I'll run `python infra/tools/anonymize_logs.py --input incident-498-logs.json` before committing.

alex: also proposing a tiny eval for prefix-cache regressions: `infra/evals/prefix_check.py --model v1.4` add to nightly.

sam: Owners + deadlines: lee (regression) PR Mon EOD; nina (prompt sets+anonymizer) PR Tue EOD; alex (load job) draft PR today; pat/ops to run drill Wed. Owners, please post PR links to #498 when ready. Reconvene Fri for a quick status.

lee: ack.

nina: ack.

alex: ack.

ops-bot: Reminder will be sent 24h before drill.
